prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an original hand-painted Japanese fantasy bullet-hell game's RGBA 3D scenery texture atlas, exactly 1024x1024 square, with four equal 512x512 quadrants in a strict 2x2 grid.
Primary request: make usable scene components, NOT a composition or landscape screenshot. Each quadrant contains exactly the specified single asset.
Style/medium: exquisite traditional Japanese ink and softly painted game background artwork, tangible fine wood/stone/paper, slightly weathered, elegant muted midtone palette, no geometric low-poly look.
Composition/framing: top-left is an OPAQUE seamless top-down floor texture filling that entire quadrant edge to edge, zero perspective, no horizon; top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right are separate isolated transparent-alpha cutout assets viewed straight-on with little or no perspective, complete silhouette, about 8% empty transparent margin around each object within its own quadrant. All the unused canvas outside these three assets must be genuinely TRANSPARENT, not black or checkerboard. Do not cross the exact quadrant boundaries. No grid lines, separators, labels, text, UI, people, bullets, watermark, cast shadow or background scene. No fake transparency. No glowing opaque black box around any object. Small painted light inside a lamp is okay. The top-left texture must stay opaque while the remaining cutouts retain real alpha. No matte backgrounds behind objects.
Lighting/mood: subdued twilight, coherent soft lighting, shadow detail; atmospheric but clearly readable hand-painted shapes. Intended for repeated 3D planes and perspective parallax, so all detail belongs to the material or cutout itself.
Color palette: ink navy, grey mossy stone, copper burnt orange, muted vermilion, warm ivory lamp.
TOP-LEFT: directly overhead seamless mossy grey flagstone mountain lane, narrow central worn stone path running exactly vertically bottom-to-top through autumn earthy ground, fine orange fallen leaves near left and right edges. Path continuity matches at top/bottom, no horizon.
TOP-RIGHT: a single majestic old vermilion Japanese torii with subtly curved black wooden upper crossbeam, two complete tall posts and blank hanging name plaque; perfectly frontal, symmetrical, no ground or scenery.
BOTTOM-LEFT: one complete dense Japanese pine and autumn maple roadside grove silhouette, multiple trunks rooted along a common bottom baseline, layered dark ink foliage with muted rust orange maple tips, nothing clipped, no ground.
BOTTOM-RIGHT: a complete slender antique Japanese wooden roadside lantern post with copper-orange cap, pale ivory lit paper lantern chamber, lower wooden support and feet; frontal view, all parts visible.
